# Events

From Warcraft Wiki

Jump to navigation Jump to search

_For events in Azeroth such as World Events and Holidays, see Event ._
    _For  Classic events, see Events/Classic ._
    _For EventRegistry callback events, see EventRegistry ._

**Frame Events** are messages sent by the WoW client to UI code (via OnEvent script handlers), mostly in reaction to things occurring in the game world. For a general tutorial on setting up event handling in your addon, see Handling events and the Frame:RegisterEvent () method.

**Event Trace**

    The Event Trace window for debugging events can be opened via the `/etrace` slash command.

**Example**

    Shows when a chat channel message appears and when you start/stop moving.

```
local function OnEvent ( self , event , ...) 
 print ( event , ...) 
 end 

 local f = CreateFrame ( "Frame" ) 
 f : RegisterEvent ( "CHAT_MSG_CHANNEL" ) 
 f : RegisterEvent ( "PLAYER_STARTED_MOVING" )

# ENCOUNTER\_END Payload Issue

WoW Classic WoW Classic Bug Report

[Rylak-3034442](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Rylak-3034442) (Rylak) February 10, 2020, 8:05am 1

I maintain and develop an addon for which part of the functionality requires detection of boss kills. I’ve noticed that with the ENCOUNTER\_END event on non-English clients, part of the payload appears to be missing information.  
While troubleshooting an issue where a boss kill was not detected with a player using a zhCN client, I examined their etrace and found the ENCOUNTER\_END entry. I found that arg 2 returned "\* instead of the boss name.  
This issue doesn’t appear to be occurring on enUS or enGB clients but I suspect that it is occurring on ruRU clients as I have had users reporting the exact same behaviour on that locale.
